title: jsontoxml action
description: Converts a JSON body to XML as json-lib does: members become elements, @name members attributes, #text text, and array items elements named elementName.

elementName.title: Element name
elementName.description: Name of the element for each array item

arrayName.title: Array name
arrayName.description: Name of the root element when the JSON is an array

rootName.title: Root name
rootName.description: Name of the root element when the JSON is an object or a value

namespaceLenient.title: Namespace lenient
namespaceLenient.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect (prefixed keys are written as they are)

typeHints.title: Type hints
typeHints.description: Give every element the attributes class (object, array) or type (string, number, boolean) that say what it is
